exportDescription: Choose the data to save and download a backup to your own storage.
restoreDescription: Choose a file, then review the restore scope and how to handle existing records.
contentConfigDescription: System settings, security policy, notifications, and system AI config
contentDatabaseDescription: Users, servers, scripts, tasks, logs, keys, sessions, and other business data
desktopContentDatabaseDescription: Local servers, scripts, tasks, activity logs, and connection-related data
sensitiveExportDescription: Include recoverable passwords, private keys, tokens, and API keys supported by this client, protected with the standard age format
desktopSensitiveExportDescription: Include recoverable server passwords and private keys, protected with the standard age format
agePassphraseHint: Keep this password safe. It is required for recovery and will not be saved.
ageRecipientsHint: A backup can target multiple recipients; any matching private identity can restore it.
restoreAgeCredentialHint: Use the original backup password or the corresponding private key.
exportHintContent: System settings and application data can be exported separately.
desktopExportHintContent: Exports local data. Enable a full backup to restore credentials on another device.
restoreHintFormat: Only data supported by this application can be restored.
restoreHintWarning: Overwriting updates existing records. Verify the file source and export your current data first if needed. When sync is enabled, restored connection settings and scripts also propagate to other devices.
conflictStrategyDescription: Config and default data are restored to the backup values; other existing database records use this strategy.
desktopConflictStrategyDescription: Existing local records use this strategy. Confirm the backup source before overwriting.
conflictSkipDescription: Keep current database data and import only records that do not exist.
conflictOverwriteDescription: Update current matching records with backup records.
conflictErrorDescription: Stop restoring as soon as any existing record is found.
confirmOverwriteRestore: Overwrite will update current matching records. Continue?
toastSelectExportContent: Select at least one export content type
toastSelectRestoreContent: Select at least one restore content type
toastAgeRecipientRequired: Enter at least one age X25519 recipient
selectFileHint: EasySSH JSON backup, up to 32 MB. Selecting a file does not start a restore.
invalidBackupFile: Choose a valid EasySSH 3.0 JSON backup (up to 32 MB).
syncDesktopDescription: Connect one remote account and keep configurations available offline. Each account retains separate data ownership.
syncServerDescription: Manage devices authorized to sync configurations owned by your current account. Sign in and approve access in a browser from the desktop app.
syncScope: Sync your own server configurations with their groups and tags, and personal scripts. Shared resources are excluded.
syncCredentialsHint: Server passwords, SSH private keys, personal AI configuration and AI conversations can be authorized and enabled separately. Connecting never uploads unselected local data.
syncDeleteHint: Deletions propagate to other devices. Sync does not replace backups; sessions, tasks, and logs remain on each device.
syncInitialHint: The first connection downloads remote configurations without uploading existing local data. Select local records to join the space afterwards; newly created or imported local records also require explicit selection.
syncDisconnectConfirm: Remove the local credential and attempt to revoke this device remotely? Offline data and its original account ownership will remain and will not be uploaded to another account automatically.
syncNoDevices: No authorized devices. Enter this server address in the desktop app, then sign in and approve access.
syncRevokeConfirm: This device will no longer be able to sync. Data already synced to the device will remain there. Continue?
syncConflictHint: Concurrent edits retain multiple versions. Choose a version to continue syncing. Save other conversation versions separately to continue each branch. Credential previews never display secrets.
syncLoginExpired: Authorization expired. Please sign in again.
syncLoginWaiting: Sign in and approve access in the browser that was opened.
syncLoginCodeHint: Check that the browser shows the same verification code. This request expires in 5 minutes.
syncRevocationPending: Signed out locally, but remote revocation could not be confirmed. Revoke this device in Web account settings.
syncEnrollHint: Unselected records keep their ownership. Local records join this space. Records from another account are copied with new identities, without passwords or private-key references; originals remain in their source space.
syncNoLocalRecords: No other configurations are available to join this space.
syncEnrollConfirm: Add {count} selected configurations to {account} ({url})? Configurations from other accounts will be copied as new records and retain their original ownership.
syncWebLoginHint: Enter this server address in the desktop app and select “Sign in with browser”. Approved devices appear below. Authorization lasts 90 days; sign out and sign in again to reconnect the same space after expiry.
syncPermissionHint: Bidirectional sync requires server management permission to create, update and delete your own connections. You can still view and revoke devices. System backup permission is not required.
syncAuthorizeDescription: Only approve a device connection you just initiated. This device can sync your personal configurations, without access to system backups or other users’ data.
syncAuthorizeCheck: I initiated this request and verified that this code matches the desktop app.
syncAuthorizeDone: Authorization complete. Return to the desktop app to finish connecting automatically.
syncScopeCredentialsHint: Sync passwords and SSH private keys for servers enrolled in this space. Temporary private-key passphrases are excluded.
syncScopeAIConfig: Personal AI configuration and API key
syncScopeAIConfigHint: Sync this space’s personal provider, models and API key. Shared system AI keys are excluded.
syncScopeSessionsHint: Sync conversations, messages, attachments and historical tool results. Received conversations use read-only permissions without restoring terminal connections or replaying tasks. New conversations join this space while enabled; existing local conversations require selection.
syncScopeNeedsGrant: This device is not authorized for this scope. Disconnect and sign in again to grant access.
syncVaultTrustHint: HTTPS protects transport; credentials and sync objects are encrypted at rest on both ends. The server can decrypt the data: connect only to a server you trust. This is not end-to-end encryption.
syncScopeDisableHint: Disabling a scope stops future sync without removing copies on other devices. Conversations, scripts and tool output may contain sensitive information.
syncCopyAIConfig: Copy local AI configuration into this space
syncCopyAIConfigConfirm: Copy the unassigned local AI configuration, including its API key, into this space, replacing its personal configuration and syncing it? Other accounts’ configurations will not be copied.
syncBasicScope: Server settings, groups, tags and scripts only
syncForkSaved: Saved as a separate conversation. The original conflict remains available for resolution.
